script_text: Stop Scorpio, the stars are screaming from your deepest underworld right now. Mercury is in retrograde in your 7th House of Partnerships, squaring Pluto in your 8th House of shared power and intimacy. That means buried trust issues are rising like magma, and secrets in close bonds will burn hot before they cool. Your love life may feel magnetic and dangerous this hour. If partnered, watch for control games or old accusations returning; if single, an intense soul will mirror your own hidden fire. In career and money, the 8th House is pulsing, so avoid merging finances or signing joint contracts impulsively. Your private resources may shift through a hidden payout or strategic partnership. Avoid keeping score in the 7th House, but an unexpected intimacy or inheritance news could arrive from an unlikely source. Follow for tomorrow's reading, brave Scorpio.
